t: The 1867 Compromise turned the Habsburg lands into a Dual Monarchy: Austria and Hungary under one ruler, Franz Joseph.
Its Vienna produced Freud, Mahler, Klimt and Wittgenstein, while Bohemia became a major industrial region.
The war it began in 1914 broke its multinational army, and it dissolved into successor states in October 1918.
dyk: Budapest was only created in 1873, by uniting Buda, Óbuda and Pest, and grew to almost 900,000 people by 1910.
ev: Prussia defeats Austria at Königgrätz, excluding it from German affairs
The Ausgleich creates the Dual Monarchy; Franz Joseph is crowned King of Hungary
Austria introduces universal male suffrage for the Reichsrat
Gavrilo Princip assassinates Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo
Brusilov Offensive breaks the army; Franz Joseph dies in November
The empire dissolves; armistice of Villa Giusti signed on 3 November
